from PIL import Image, ImageFilter, ImageDraw
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
im = Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
blur = np.asarray(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(21))).astype(np.float32)
diff = blur - a  # darker than local mean
diff = ndimage.gaussian_filter(diff, 3)
thr = np.percentile(diff, 97)
mask = diff > thr
lab, n = ndimage.label(mask)
objs = ndimage.find_objects(lab)
sizes = ndimage.sum(mask, lab, range(1, n+1))
cands = []
for i, sl in enumerate(objs):
    area = sizes[i]
    if area < 800 or area > 60000:  # skip tiny noise and huge regions
        continue
    ys, xs = np.where(lab[sl] == i+1)
    y0, x0 = sl[0].start, sl[1].start
    cy, cx = ys.mean()+y0, xs.mean()+x0
    h = sl[0].stop - sl[0].start; w = sl[1].stop - sl[1].start
    # roundish: bbox aspect and fill
    fill = area / (h*w)
    aspect = max(h,w)/min(h,w)
    if fill > 0.45 and aspect < 2.6:
        cands.append((cx, cy, w, h, area))
print(len(cands))
for c in sorted(cands, key=lambda t:-t[4]):
    print(f"cx={c[0]:.0f} cy={c[1]:.0f} w={c[2]} h={c[3]} area={c[4]:.0f}")
